hypothesis: Every database operation goes through MetricsHandler, and the light-phase profile showed metrics_util's Registry::get_or_create at ~1.9% self time (RwLock read on the metric map, an Arc clone and its drop per lookup) plus the per-transaction handler setup. --db.disable-metrics removes the handler. No rebuild; runtime flag only. Expect ~1-3%, mostly on the light phase.
llm_commentary: --db.disable-metrics removes the per-transaction MetricsHandler and the metrics-registry lookups the light-phase profile showed at ~1.9% self (RwLock read on the metric map plus an Arc clone and drop per lookup). Measured against the same-boot control: m9g 4.72s [4.76/4.75/4.65] → 4.62s [4.63/4.69/4.54], -2.1% with overlapping ranges; m8azn-3xl 4.51s → 4.49s, -0.4%. So the direction matches the profile but the size sits inside Graviton5's ±3% drift — suggestive, not proven. Worth a repeat pair if the night's other levers leave time; it is in any case an operational flag, not a code change, and a node that needs DB metrics should keep them.
